title: Pacific Northwest Travel Poster
coreRelationships: The foreground elements (tree trunks and figures) frame and direct attention towards the expansive middle-ground landscape.
The large, stylized mountains in the background create a sense of grandeur and depth.
The body of water acts as a central visual element, reflecting the sky and separating the foreground from the distant mountains.
The text elements are integrated into the sky and bottom border, providing context and a call to action.
The use of strong, defined shapes and limited color palette creates a graphic, Art Deco aesthetic.
reuseFormula: Recreate a stylized landscape with prominent mountains, a body of water, and forests, framed by large foreground elements. Integrate human figures observing the scene. Use a limited, high-contrast color palette with strong outlines, reminiscent of Art Deco travel posters. Place promotional text in the sky and bottom border. Adjust mountain shapes, water color, and foreground details to vary the specific location and mood while maintaining the core aesthetic.
